3. Select Copilot Studio or Azure AI Foundry to see a filtered list of AI agents based on the
tool used to create the agent.
4. To see detailed information about a specific AI agent, select the agent from the list.
When you select an AI agent from the inventory, the Agent pane opens, providing detailed
information about the selected agent. The information displayed varies based on whether the
agent was created in Azure AI Foundry or Copilot Studio.
-- Select Open agent page to open the AI Agent page.
